preservedResponsibilities: The source size-gated field writes and unknown-encoding fallback use min/max/average character sizes and flags captured from pinned ImplTextEncodingData for all 55 represented single-byte converters plus UTF-8. The CONTEXT/ASCII choice used by Calc CSV export therefore follows the native metadata rather than a guessed encoding category.
omittedResponsibilities: Metadata for unrepresented multi-byte/contextual converters and unrelated tencinfo queries remains outside this runtime slice.
